description: This source file defines an enum 'ExecShellWrapperParser' that provides functions to detect and extract shell wrapper commands from an input command array. It supports POSIX, Windows CMD, and PowerShell wrappers, with specific logic to parse inline commands and nested environments.

classes.name: ExecShellWrapperParser
classes.description: A namespace enum encapsulating static methods and internal data structures for parsing shell wrapper commands.

classes.name: ExecShellWrapperParser.ParsedShellWrapper
classes.description: A struct representing the result of parsing a command to determine if it is a shell wrapper, including its type and command string.

classes.name: ExecShellWrapperParser.Kind
classes.description: An enum representing different shell types: POSIX, CMD, and PowerShell.

classes.name: ExecShellWrapperParser.WrapperSpec
classes.description: A struct associating a shell type with a set of recognized command names.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Public method to parse a command array and raw command string to detect if it is a shell wrapper.

methods.name: extract(command:preferredRaw:depth:)
methods.description: Private recursive method that performs the core parsing logic, considering wrapper specifications and nested environment calls.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Selects the appropriate inline command extraction method based on the shell type.

methods.name: extractPosixInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline POSIX shell commands from command arguments.

methods.name: extractCmdInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline Windows CMD commands from command arguments.

methods.name: extractPowerShellInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline PowerShell commands from command arguments.
